sections.title: Often and rarely
sections.content: You know the frequency words: *mindig* (always), *gyakran* (often), *néha* (sometimes), *ritkán* (rarely). It goes before the place or the verb: *Gyakran a parkba megyek.* *Ritkán megyek a kórházba.* You know *Milyen gyakran …?*; here ask *Milyen gyakran mész a moziba?* and also ask *Hová mész délután?*

items.english: I often go to the park.
I rarely go to the hospital.
How often do you go to the cinema?
Sometimes I go to the museum.
Where are you going in the afternoon?

sections.content: *Soha* needs *nem*: *Soha nem megyek a moziba.* The other four words do not.
